mintAuthority.summary: tGBP uses transparent proxies on five EVM chains and a standard SPL Token mint on Solana. EOA 0xAF4fCE...595C0 controls EVM minting and four live ProxyAdmin paths; Avalanche's ProxyAdmin is self-owned. Solana minting is controlled by a 1-of-2 SPL multisig.

controls.label: StableTokenV1OFT owner (mint/burn + upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: Current RPC reads on 2026-07-14 returned this EOA from owner() on Ethereum block 25530550, Base block 48619375, BSC block 109930595, Polygon block 90215403, and Avalanche block 90285011. All five deployments are transparent proxies using ProxyAdmin 0x666b8f67969a22a4015d6d523d8671ee714b114f. The ProxyAdmin owner is this EOA on Ethereum, Base, BSC, and Polygon; Avalanche's ProxyAdmin instead returns itself as owner, leaving that chain's implementation replacement path inaccessible through an external owner.

controls.label: tGBP Solana mint-authority multisig
controls.evidence: A finalized Solana RPC read on 2026-07-14 decoded the tGBP mint as an initialized standard SPL Token mint with this address as both mint and freeze authority. The authority account decoded as an initialized 1-of-2 SPL Token multisig.

review.evidence: Current RPC reads on 2026-07-14 covered every tracked deployment. Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, and Avalanche use transparent proxies at the common token address. Their implementations resolve to 0x94321d80... on Ethereum, 0xc608f775... on Base/BSC/Avalanche, and 0xe6ef9733... on Polygon. ProxyAdmin 0x666b8f... is owned by the reviewed EOA on four chains and self-owned on Avalanche. The Solana deployment is a standard immutable SPL Token mint controlled by a 1-of-2 multisig. The reviewed EOA therefore retains immediate mint-logic replacement on four EVM deployments, while Avalanche and Solana expose no external code-replacement authority. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Andersen LLP performs monthly independent agreed-upon procedures; the latest report covers 2026-06-30 and was published 2026-07-14, reconciling tGBP liabilities to reserve bank balances. FCA records match BCP Technologies Ltd only as a registered cryptoasset business, and the issuer states tGBP is not e-money and lacks FSCS coverage, so no prudential issuer supervision is credited. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: unbounded EVM owner and Solana multisig mint paths; monthly Andersen full-liability reconciliation exists without prudential product supervision.
